people.name: Hashmonah
people.line: A desert campsite during Israel's journey from Egypt.

people.name: Moseroth
people.line: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings

translations.web: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.
translations.bsb: They set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
translations.kjv: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
